summary_1line: Draupadi, dragged into the Kuru assembly after the dice game, demands to know if she was truly won, while elders hesitate and Bhishma admits the dilemma of dharma.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dussasana drags the trembling Draupadi by force into the crowded Kuru assembly while kings watch in silence.
Draupadi, fallen on the floor of the court with disheveled hair, raises her hands and asks the assembled kings whether she is a slave or a queen.
Bhishma sits with head bowed among silent elders as Draupadi stands pleading in the royal court.
